svg.title: To derive it at s = r, factor Gs = [I +(s−r)(A−I)G−1 r ]Gr. The coefficient of t in det(I +tB) is trace B, as follows directly from the determinant polynomial. Differentiate the factored determinant and then log|·|. The inverse is continuous along this compact interpolation by the adjugate formula and nonvanishing determinant. Integrating therefore gives
